data.name: Jesus Simulator
data.detailed_description:
You become a witness to one of the most important stories in human history - the earthly life of Jesus Christ. Jesus Simulator is a narrative-driven game that faithfully retells the events of the Gospel, drawing from biblical texts and historically reliable sources. The journey begins with Jesus’ early life and follows His ministry through sermons, miracles, and encounters with disciples and people from all walks of life. Through dialogue, travel, and key story moments, players explore the core values of Christian teaching: love, mercy, forgiveness, faith, and sacrifice.

Game Features:

• Narrative Visual Novel Experience: The story unfolds as an atmospheric visual novel, with pivotal moments enhanced by interactive mini-games.

• Multiple Perspectives: Experience the story through different biblical figures, including Mary, Joseph, Jesus, and His disciples, offering deeper insight through shifting viewpoints.

• Key Gospel Events: Take part in the recreation of iconic miracles, presented with respect for their original meaning and symbolism.

• Authentic Locations: Visit significant places from the Gospel, carefully recreated to reflect their historical and cultural context.

• Respectful Artistic Vision: Biblical figures are depicted thoughtfully, allowing even newcomers to understand the foundations of Christian imagery and belief.

Jesus Simulator is more than a game - it is an interactive journey of faith, choice, and spiritual reflection.

Live the story. Become a witness. Discover its meaning.
